rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for being unsuccessful in general.

example.english: We all know the plan will fail this time.
example.traditional: 我哋都知今次個計劃會失敗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dou1 zi1 gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 wui5 sat1 baai6

rows.note: Use this when someone or something fails to carry out a specified action or reach a stated goal.

example.english: We fail to catch the last train.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gon2 m4 dou2 mei5 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this for a machine or device that has stopped working properly.

example.english: The air conditioner will fail completely if we do not repair it.
example.traditional: 部冷氣壞咗，再唔整就會完全用唔到。
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2 zoi3 m4 zing2 zau6 wui5 jyun4 cyun4 jung6 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this colloquial school-related expression when a student fails a subject or, transitively, when a teacher fails the student.

example.english: I will fail maths this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 sou3 hok6 fei4 zo2
